notes.title: Major update September 29th!
notes.content:
[p]First off I would like to thank all the early supporters and players! We appreciate all of your feedback.  [/p][p]Our first major update includes essential features, overall polish, and much more! [/p][p][b]
Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Arena mode asynchronous game mode.[/p][/*][*][p]New items.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability changes. [/p][/*][*][p]Premade pack updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Entire UI/UX Overhaul.[/p][/*][*][p]Friendly battles now can use any pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Basic gameplay Tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]View opponent's team. (Can now view last round opponent's team).[/p][/*][*][p]Temporary Ranked ban system for abusing game abandonment for gaining ranked rating.[/p][/*][*][p]Many more essential UI/UX features for clarity to gameplay.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Core changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]XP orbs are no longer free at the beginning of each round. 
Instead are a normal Tier 2 item. 
In preparation for the (Arena mode) launch this was a essential change as power creep was too fast leaving later rounds feeling empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Consumables now can be stacked repeatedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities now deal double damage against a target weakness (Halved for resist). [/p][/*][*][p]Elemental potion: Increases base elemental damage and ability damage. (Up to 40%)[/p][/*][*][p]Resist potion: Increases base elemental resist and ability resistance. (Up to 40%)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Starters no longer gain 1 XP per round.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Arena mode [/b][/p][list][*][p]Asynchronous multiplayer, allowing for endless play without matchmaking or timers.[/p][/*][*][p]Win 10 rounds before loosing 5 lifepoints.[/p][/*][*][p]View your next opponent allowing for strategic decision making. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]What's next?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Our priority will be releasing the rest of 121 index. (Updates to premade packs).[/p][/*][*][p]More items (Expanding the amount of items in each pack/build).[/p][/*][*][p]Custom games [/p][/*][*][p]Ranked arena[/p][/*][/list][p]Many bugs were fixed, too many to list here. 

Appreciate your patience, we are a very small team and aiming to deliver a much higher quality experience. 

Thank you for all for the ongoing support, and we hope to see you in the Arena!  [/p]

notes.title: Asychrounus Multiplayer/Features
notes.content:
The team and I are looking into removing real time play in casual matchmaking.

Shifting Casual mode to an Asychrounus format with no timers and no queue times. Players builds and round data will be saved to a database allowing for battles to be against other player's builds every match.

This feature will help players enjoy the game when matchmaking is slow, due to a growing player base.

We are also looking into a tips and tricks system that will guide players around the basic mechanics of the game to improve players first match experience. helping assisting them through the management phase.

We will make a new announcement soon regarding a time frame for these features to be implemented!

Our UI is needs adjustment for resolutions below 1920x1080 and are working on this now to improve the experience for players on smaller resolutions.

Thank you to all the players who are active and leaving feedback to improve our game. FaeTerra will only improve from here, and I am excited to see what it will become!
 
All the best 
- Dez

notes.title: Post launch 2025 Content roadmap!
notes.content:
We would like to share with you our Roadmap for FaeTerra.
If the launch of FaeTerra is well received we will firstly address any bugs affecting the game.
We will prioritize improving core features of the game first, and then move on to implementing new 
in-game features. 

We are a very small team so we appreciate your patience.

[b][h2]2025 Content Roadmap[/h2][/b]

Near future updates:

[*]Addressing critical issues
[*]Prioritize bug fixes
[*]UI/UX improvements and usability
[*]Tutorials 
[*]Asynchronous multiplayer.
[*]Store/Shop content Skins customizables.
[*]More Store purchase usage of FaeCoins.
[*]Balancing Creatures #001-#073.
[*]Ability to super roll Tier 2 creatures in the shop after round 3 (Costs 2 gold).
[*]Ability to Max roll Tier 3 creatures in the shop after round 5 (Costs 3 gold).

Planned Future Updates:

[*]Localization 5-7 languages
[*]Interactive tutorial
[*]Introduce class abilities offering more team building mechanics.
[*]More classes and premade packs.
[*]Improving friends list and player interactions between friends. 
[*]Arena mode - Asynchronous multiplayer game mode. 
[*]Custom game mode - with custom rule sets, expanding game mechanics.
[*]Release of creatures #074-#112.

Planned Far future Updates
[*]Trials of the Citadel - FaeTerra and Solfiregames wants to bring an amazing PVE experience that will offer a Rogue-like adventure through the world of FaeTerra and expanding the lore and game play mechanics. (This mode is in early concept inspired by games like Slay the Spire and Pokémon's battle tower). 

We want to heavily involve player feedback into all aspects of FaeTerra. If you have ideas for the game post in the community discussions or discord! Thank you for playing!

We need your support! you can assist our development buy purchases in game or following us on Kickstarter. We will be launching our Kickstarter soon!

Hope you all are enjoying FaeTerra and be sure to follow us on socials @Solfiregames for updates.

notes.title: FaeTerra is OUT NOW today!!
notes.content:
FaeTerra started as a solo development passion project. 
With early prototypes exhibiting potential, I decided to pursue a dream to release my first commercial game. 

I grew up inspired by creature collection games and always had a taste for the competitive battling aspect. 

With this in mind, I started carving out the basics stumbling upon the growing genre of auto battlers.

Immediately sparking a vision of capturing the most fun parts of a creature collector, for me it was crafting the coolest team for battling. 

FaeTerra tries to scratch this itch of team-building, evolving, and battling. Trying new compositions against friends and opponents in PVP!

With the help from Juego Studios together we created FaeTerra! 

I hope players can see the vision for this title, as this is just a launch point and stepping stone for FaeTerra with hopes to expand this universe in a much bigger way in the future!

We look forward to your support!!! Thank you.

- Dez solfire

notes.title: Release date for FaeTerra!
notes.content:
FaeTerra build 1.0 will be releasing on May 7th, we appreciate your patience! An incompetent former team member released the demo as the main game, so we temporarily removed FaeTerra from our Steam page. 

However despite many challenges we persevered and now arriving at our official release. May 7th @ 11am (CDT)

FaeTerra is heavily inspired by Super Auto Pets and Pokémon, with the fantastic game play and mechanics of SAP and the nostalgic essence of Pokémon, we aim to bring a new title to the creature collection and auto-battler genres.

I am super thrilled to have reached this milestone of releasing Solfiregames first title and hope to grow the FaeTerra IP. Thank you to my development team at Juesgo Studios for their brilliant engineering on this project.

All the best,
Dez
